title: A collection of FAIR Dutch Freedom of Information Act documents
descriptions: This dataset contains a set of documents released through the Dutch FOIA legislation (Woo), collected from over a thousand suppliers, and provided with a rich set of metadata. The main portion of the dataset is in the 'dataset' zip folder, which contains all passively released documents that were collected. The dataset also contains actively released files, a relatively new category, these are stored in the 'EXTRA-actively-released' folder. Finally, the dataset contains several examples notebooks in the 'notebooks' folder, including detailed information on the dataset sources, how to load the dataset, and how to retrieve the linke PDF files. Usage Notes By default, the files in the dataset are shown in a flat list structure, with is nice if you only want to download just a few files, but a bit problematic if you want to see the complete structure of the folder. You can change this by changes to the 'Tree' file structure in the overview.
